summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_secret and client_id; client_id from login then extra.client_id, client_secret from password then extra.client_secret; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var references for both secrets). Registered it directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings, and added it to the export lists in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claiming, token-over-OAuth selection with login plus password, OAuth selection, profile and YAML output, override protection, and env-var outputs. Tests were not run, per the instructions; expected values were verified by reading the code only. Nothing was committed.
